title: Video Editing — Objective Assessment
description: Module 1 & Module 2 objective assessment. 15 multiple-choice questions.
instructions: Answer all 15 questions. Select the most appropriate answer from the options provided. Multiple-choice questions are marked automatically when you submit.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between a J-cut and an L-cut?
options: A J-cut changes video speed, while an L-cut changes audio pitch.
A J-cut removes the previous scene's audio, while an L-cut removes the next scene's audio.
A J-cut and an L-cut are both techniques for increasing music volume.
In a J-cut, the next scene's audio begins before its video appears; in an L-cut, the previous scene's audio continues after the video changes.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of cutting and trimming footage?
options: To increase the video's resolution.
To keep the useful parts of a clip and remove unnecessary sections.
To automatically add music to the video.
To change a landscape video into portrait.

questions.prompt: Which type of shot is primarily used to establish where a scene takes place?
options: Extreme close-up
Cowboy shot
Medium close-up
Establishing shot

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of using the Mark Beats feature when editing music in CapCut?
options: To remove background noise from recorded audio.
To increase the volume of every music track.
To separate the audio from the video automatically.
To identify beats in a song so video clips can be aligned with the music.

questions.prompt: In the tutorial, why does the instructor separate individual words into different text layers?
options: To make the video file smaller.
To allow individual words to have different fonts, positions, colours, and animations.
To prevent the captions from appearing on screen.
To automatically correct spelling mistakes.

questions.prompt: Why is rearranging clips important when building a video?
options: The order of clips can affect the flow, meaning, and story of the video.
It automatically improves the quality of every clip.
It removes the need to trim footage.
It changes the video's aspect ratio.

questions.prompt: A filmmaker wants to make a character appear powerful and dominant in a scene. Which camera angle would best support this intention?
options: High-angle shot
Low-angle shot
Extreme close-up
Over-the-shoulder shot

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of using keyframes to control music volume?
options: They automatically remove unwanted sounds from a recording.
They allow the editor to gradually change volume levels instead of creating abrupt transitions.
They synchronise all video clips with external microphones.
They convert background music into sound effects.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of enabling the Instagram interface preview while positioning captions?
options: To automatically add Instagram music to the video.
To change all captions to Instagram's default font.
To increase the size of the video timeline.
To ensure captions do not appear behind interface elements such as buttons.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the proper use of transitions?
options: Every clip should have a different transition.
Transitions should be used as frequently as possible.
Transitions should replace good editing decisions.
Transitions should serve the edit rather than distract from it.

questions.prompt: According to the instructor, why might cutting a video one frame before a beat drops create a smoother viewing experience?
options: It can make the visual cut feel more naturally synchronised with the music.
It increases the video's frame rate automatically.
It prevents the music from playing during transitions.
It removes the need to edit the audio track.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of CapCut's Enhanced Voice feature, as explained in the tutorial?
options: To reduce background noise and improve voice clarity.
To add music markers to a soundtrack.
To create J-cuts and L-cuts automatically.
To increase the resolution of video footage.

questions.prompt: An editor wants a caption to move upward while also becoming less blurry. According to the tutorial, which technique can help create this customised motion?
options: Changing the video's aspect ratio several times.
Applying the same font to every text layer.
Using transform keyframes to control the caption's movement and adjusting the animation's speed curve.
Increasing the background music volume.

questions.prompt: You created a video in landscape format, but you want to publish it as a portrait video for a platform that uses vertical content. What should you do?
options: Split every clip in the timeline.
Change the project's aspect ratio from landscape to portrait and adjust the framing as needed.
Add a transition between every clip.
Increase the video's frame rate.

questions.prompt: What is the potential problem with cutting scenes too quickly?
options: It automatically lowers the video's resolution.
It makes every scene feel emotional.
It can confuse viewers and make it difficult for them to follow what is happening.
It prevents the editor from adding music.
